messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters. This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascal. Default is standard atmospheric pressure. This is a float type value.

message.content: 我不太確定您的問題是想知道「在這種情況下，最終的氣體壓力是多少？」還是「氣體量（摩爾數）會改變多少」？請再說明一下您想要得到哪個結果。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" They want to know how much gas will be produced? Actually they might mean what pressure will result? The question: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" In Chinese: "How much gas will be produced when heating a 2 cubic meter sealed chamber from 25°C to 100°C?" That seems ambiguous: maybe they want to calculate the change in pressure or amount of gas? The phrase "會產生多少氣體" literally means "how much gas will be produced". But if it's a sealed chamber, no gas is produced; but pressure changes. Maybe they want to compute the new pressure using ideal gas law. So we need to ask clarifying question: "請問您想計算的是最終壓力還是氣體量變化?" We can ask clarifying question.
